code:
EXPLAIN MATCH (p:Person {name:'Marcus Lee'})
RETURN p
-- plan only, nothing executes

PROFILE MATCH (p:Person {name:'Marcus Lee'})
RETURN p
-- runs it: real rows, db hits, time
caption: EXPLAIN = estimated plan. PROFILE = actual plan with STATISTICS IO.
